physics._source: Ball: 2026 Game Manual 5.10.1 (5.91 in, 0.448-0.500 lb; AndyMark 215 g target). Air 1.204 kg/m^3 (20 C sea level). Cd 0.55 / Cl = min(0.8 S, 0.35) / spinRatio 0.9 = passive-hood preset from the open-source cross-check (6328, 6940, 5572 maps; every open sim uses Cd 0.47; CD thread 394940 kinematics). Drag and lift trade off; tune the mechanism knobs, not these.

hub._source: Manual 5.4 + field drawings p.25: front edge of the opening at 72 in, hexagon 41.7 in across flats (inscribed half-width 0.5296 m), hub 47 in square (face 0.5969 m from centre). windowInset/lipClearance are margins (assumed). apexMax 7.0 m = 25 ft venue minimum ceiling; use 3.5 m for a 12 ft practice space.

selection._source: 4414's rule: maximise the weakest of (speed margin / sigmaSpeed, angle margin / sigmaAngle), speed at the middle of the scoring window. sigmaSpeed 0.2 m/s ~ our +/-2 rps flywheel gate; sigmaAngle 1 deg (Aieda/2084/Tyler). Refine with a 20-shot test.

grid._source: Distance = turret axis to hub centre (2D). Radial velocity + = closing on the hub. SOTM drive is throttled to 25% (1.5 m/s).

tangential._source: Plus per-shot mechanism limits (hood min angle, flywheel max) computed by the generator. Bearing-rate rule from 6328 DriveCommands; set null to disable.

sotm._source: 6328/1540 phase delay 30 ms; 5962 mechanism latency 20 ms. Measure feed-to-exit delay on video.
